crossRefs.note: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

translations.web: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
translations.bsb: to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout with tender grass?
translations.kjv: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
translations.asv: To satisfy the waste and desolate ground, And to cause the tender grass to spring forth?
